name: mapaware_xpoint_corrector
author: first_agent
question: Given a finished map made by networks that never saw the shot, can a corrector that reads the map around its X-points plus the inputs move the boundary saddles toward the true raw-map saddles selectively enough to lower D without hurting other terms?
data: the five OOF archives (fold k maps of 80 fold-k training shots each, kfold_build.py), every 2nd frame
target: per end (lower, upper): true raw-map saddle position minus the OOF map's saddle position (both from x_point.boundary_saddles); rows where both exist
features: map-side: saddle R,Z and its Hessian (3), normalised saddle flux (phi_s - phi_b)/(phi_axis - phi_b), the other end's saddle R,Z and flux gap, LCFS lowest/highest point R,Z, axis R,Z, the seven derived scalars read from the map; input-side: the 367 table features
model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor per target coordinate (max_iter 400, learning_rate 0.05, max_leaf_nodes 31, l2 1.0, early_stopping False, random_state 0); uncertainty per end = HistGB (max_iter 200) on log(|residual 2-D| + 1e-4) of inner cross-fitted predictions
evaluation: nested cross-fit over the 5 folds: for each outer fold j, fit on the other four folds' OOF maps (uncertainty model from an inner 4-fold cross-fit), predict fold j; every metric is on fold j maps only

arms.gated_full: move an end with x_point.with_x_points to map saddle + predicted correction only if |correction| >= 0.001 m and |correction| >= 2 * sigma; share 1

metrics: per frame D (scorer Hausdorff / rgeo), seven derived-scalar squared errors and flux SSE versus the true map; per shot mean D change; 20000 shot bootstrap (seed 930)
on_pass: freeze: final corrector = fitted on all five folds' OOF maps; apply to v25 (65-member) full357 validation maps; ONE official-scorer full357 screen with paired whole-shot CI against v25; submission decision only after that and public-test transfer checks
on_fail: record; no threshold or hyperparameter tuning on these folds
